Name: Uzzi, Son of Tola
Summary: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 7:2: Son of Tola and head of his father's house, a valiant man of might.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Uzzi stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
